scripts.build: npm run db:bundle && npm run routes:generate && npm run typecheck && vite build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:worker
scripts.upload: npm run build && wrangler versions upload
scripts.build:node: npm run db:bundle && npm run routes:generate && npm run typecheck && MAILFLARE_RUNTIME=node vite build && node scripts/build-server.mjs

CF_TOKEN.description: Runtime Cloudflare API token used by Mailflare onboarding to call the Zones, DNS, and Email Routing APIs. Cloudflare's deploy/build token is not passed to the app, so create this separately at https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens with `Zone Read`, `DNS Edit`, `Email Routing Edit`, and `Email Routing Rules Write` permissions for the zones you will connect. Add `Email Sending Edit` to enable outbound mail. Paste only the token secret value, without `Bearer`.

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: Cloudflare Turnstile secret key used to verify login and first-run registration challenges. Pair with VITE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY at build time.

VITE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Cloudflare Turnstile public site key used by the login and first-run registration widgets.

CF_EMAIL_WORKER_NAME.description: Worker name used when creating Cloudflare Email Routing rules. Set this to the deployed Worker name; if you rename the Worker, update this value too.

GITHUB_UPDATE_TOKEN.description: Fine-grained GitHub token for the installation repository with Actions: write permission. Used by the admin update endpoint to dispatch deploy-update.yml.

GITHUB_UPDATE_REF.description: Optional branch used to dispatch updates. Leave blank to use the repository default branch.

GITHUB_UPDATE_REPO.description: Your github repository that connect to cloudflare worker

CF_EMAIL.description: Legacy Global API Key auth only. Use this with `CF_API_KEY` instead of `CF_TOKEN`.

CF_API_KEY.description: Legacy Global API Key auth only. Prefer `CF_TOKEN` for new deployments.
